0.long_answer: PfEMP1, a protein expressed by Plasmodium falciparum on infected erythrocytes, binds to the complement receptor 1 (CR1) on red blood cells. The CR1 gene is located on the long arm of human chromosome 1 at band 32 (1q32). This binding interaction plays a key role in the process of rosetting, which contributes to the pathogenesis of malaria by aiding the sequestration of infected erythrocytes.
